The baseline's first charge capacity was 205.6 mAh/g, and the recovered NMC622's first charge capacity was 194.0 mAh/g. 

To find the percentage by which the recovered NMC622's first charge capacity fell short of the baseline's, we can calculate the difference between the two capacities and divide it by the baseline capacity.

The difference is 205.6 - 194.0 = 11.6 mAh/g.

The percentage by which the recovered NMC622's first charge capacity fell short of the baseline's is (11.6 / 205.6) * 100 = 5.66%.
